description: The bar chart illustrates how the metric labeled \(\gamma_B\) varies across different “Number of Shots,” with two side-by-side bars per shot count representing two conditions indicated by color/pattern (a blue dotted series and a magenta diagonally hatched series labeled “Correct” in the legend). The horizontal axis contains the categories 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 in ascending order and is labeled “Number of Shots.” The vertical axis is labeled \(\gamma_B\) and uses a linear scale starting at 0.0, with visible tick labels at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, and 0.6 (regular 0.2 intervals), and the plotted bars extend to just above 0.7. For each shot count, the blue dotted bar is approximately 0.41 (0 shots), 0.40 (1), 0.37 (2), 0.33 (3), and 0.30 (4), while the magenta hatched “Correct” bar is approximately 0.71 (0), 0.68 (1), 0.65 (2), 0.63 (3), and 0.45 (4). The bars are grouped by shot count with the blue bar on the left and the magenta bar on the right within each group; no stacking is used, and there are no additional annotations or special emphasis beyond the distinct colors and hatch patterns.
